body:
From the #569 follow-up (`fix/569-plot-registration`, plot_labor/plot_inputs registration).

- Mali serves `Family` / `Hired` / `Other` (capitalised). Every other EHCVM / ISA country serves lower-case `family` / `hired` (/ `other`).
- GhanaSPS serves 7 per-instrument values (`casual`, `communal`, `family`, `hired`, `other`, `permanent`, `self`), and GhanaLSS serves `exchange` / `hired`.
- So `Feature('plot_labor').groupby('source')` splits Mali from everyone else.
- **Tier:** A for the Mali case fix (one country re-warm). C for a cross-country `harmonize_labor_source` decision.
title: #569 residual D: the `plot_labor.source` vocabulary is not harmonised across countries
